text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Bank Statement * 2. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 3. Study plan A study plan of more than 500 words, focusing on the study plan of the applied major. Applicants must write in the language of the applied major. * 4. Digital Signature -Please sign your name on a white sheet of paper and send us a scanned copy. -This will be used solely for digitally signing relevant application documents on your behalf. * 5. Personal CV/Resume * 6. Letter of good faith undertaking You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. 3-minute video Record in the language of the applied major. * 8. Certificate of HSK (Not need for English medium program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) * 9. The medical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 11. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 12. High school academic transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 13. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -The compulsory subjects for GXMU are mathematics and chemistry. Applicants for the undergraduate clinical medicine program (taught in English) (MBBS) must choose the English test paper and do not need to provide Chinese subject scores; Applicants for other programs must choose the Chinese test paper and must provide STEM Chinese; Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
